turns.text: The Paris Agreement is an international treaty adopted in 2015 under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). It aims to hold the increase in global average temperature to well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels and to pursue efforts to limit it to 1.5°C. Each party sets its own targets in a Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), updated every five years, and progress is reviewed collectively in a global stocktake.
turns.title: Paris Agreement

IAM results are scenario projections, not forecasts. Each scenario shows what would happen if its assumptions held (policies, technology costs, population, economic growth); it does not say how likely that future is. Comparing scenarios shows the effect of different policy choices, and comparing models on the same scenario shows how much the answer depends on model structure.
